notes: Whole-book and parent-article groups stay together; inherited source partitions are retained.
Target size derives from the limiting genre capacity; no requested total word cap and no repetition.
Keep named-author/byline web journalism separate in confidence basis from historical literary works and frozen Wikipedia.
All retained authorship labels are candidates, with no measured human-only guarantee or contamination rate.
Mechanical WikiText punctuation restoration is deterministic and recorded; no learned rewriting or generated summaries.
Gutenberg catalog summaries and reading guides are explicitly excluded; only text inside ebook body markers is eligible.
Legacy WikiText tokenizer spacing may remain; benchmark formatting is a potential detector shortcut.
Book acquisition dates and ebook update dates differ from original publication dates.
Do not combine this overlapping mixture with corpus-words-v2 or human-core-v1 as additional unique training text.
News article captured-version uncertainty and license discrepancies remain explicit.
Source and author limits increase diversity but do not establish topic, author or generator independence.
